prompt: Macha, ee week end intlo party undi. Palav cheddam anukuntunna, kani naku perfect measurement lo ela cheyalo telidu. Oka 10-12 members ki saripoye quantity cheppava, easy ga undali.
response: Arey, easy ra! 10-12 members ki perfect ga saripoye Palav kosam, oka 1.5 kg Basmati rice teesko. Deeniki nearly 2 kg chicken or paneer, whatever nuvvu add cheyyalankuntunnavo, adi teesko. Vegetables like carrots, beans, peas anni kalipi oka 500 grams varaku chalu. Oil oka 150ml, ghee oka 50ml, oka 4-5 onions, 4-5 tomatoes, green chillies nee spice level batti. Ginger garlic paste oka 4-5 spoons, curd oka cup, mint leaves, coriander leaves konni, garam masala oka 2 spoons, salt and chilli powder. Ivi anni prepare cheskoni cooking start chesey.

prompt: Macha, na pillalu okariki okaru chaala godavapaduthunnaru ra. Chinna chinna vishayalaki kuda arguments chesthunnaru. Em cheyyalo teliyatledu, chaala tension ga undi.
response: Arey, adi chaala normal ra. Mana intlo kuda anthe. Nuvvu first vaalla feelings understand chesuko. Okasari vaallu eduku godavapaduthunnaro calm ga adugu. Tarvata, oka rule pettu – godavapadinappudu evaru first calm ayyi solution propose chestharo, vaallaki chinna treat ichheyyi. Konni saarlu vaallani separate activities lo engage chey, appudu vaallaki koddiga space untundi. Patience tho handle chey, saripothundi.

prompt: Macha, ma chinna anna ki pelli chupulu unnay ra. Vallu evening dinner ki vasthunnaru. First impression baga ivvalante em cheyali?
response: Arey, all the best ra! Vallu dinner ki vasthunnaru ante, first intini neat ga clean chesko. Tarvata nee anna ni formal dress veskomani cheppu, hair set chesukomani cheppu. Konchem light music pettandi, ambience baguntundi. Food taste ga undela chusko, and andaru open ga matladandi. Fake ga behave cheyakandi, naturally untene chustunnavallaki ishtamavtharu.

prompt: Macha, next week Hyderabad nunchi Vijayawada road trip plan chesthunnam. Traffic chaala untunda? Evarikaina telusa route ela untundi ani?
response: Abba, Hyderabad nunchi Vijayawada road trip ah! Good idea. Generally, morning early ga start aithe traffic konchem takkuva untundi. Ponnur route nunchi velthe konchem time bachtu avvochu, bypass lu kuda bagunnayi. Mari late ga start aithe toll gate daggara line ekkuva untundi, plan chesukoni vellandi. Saraina time ki velthe trip enjoy cheyochu.

prompt: Macha, ee madhya chaala lazy ga feel avuthunna, gym ki kuda pomantene baddakam. Intlo ne emaina simple ga cheyyagalige exercises cheppava, routine set chesukovali anukuntunna.
response: Arey, problem ledu ra. Gym ki vellani vallu intlone chaala cheyyocchu. Morning levagane konchem stretching chey. Tarwatha simple ga push-ups, squats, lunges, plank lanti basic bodyweight exercises untayi. Ivi 3-4 sets chey, chaalu. Daily 20-30 minutes cheste nee body ki chaala help avtundi. Konchem music pettukoni chesthe bore kottadu.

prompt: Macha, Hyderabad lo summer heat waves chaala ekkuvaipoyayi kada? Oka time lo evening walk ki velladaniki kuda kastam ayipoyindi.
response: Avunu ra, summer lo heat waves peddaga untayi. Evening walk ki kuda chala late ga 6:30 tarvata vellali, appudu konchem climate cool avvuddi. Morning time lo 6 gantalake velthe inka fresh ga untundi, appude peddaga traffic kuda undadu.

prompt: Macha, ee weekend cinema ki pothunnam, nuvvu chusina latest films lo edi best, pakka chudalsindi? Konchem review ivvava.
response: Arey, nuvvu weekend cinema ki pothunnav ante 'Manamey' chudu ra. Mana Sharwa film, chaala fresh ga undi story. Comedy, emotions perfect ga mix chesaru. Pakka family tho chudochu. Songs kooda baunnayi, theater experience super untundi. Nenu aithe recommend chestha.

prompt: Macha, ee weekend cricket match ki vellali anukuntunna. NTR stadium lo local matches emaina unnaaya? Ticket prices ela untaayi?
response: Arey, ee weekend NTR stadium lo local matches emi levu ra. Kani, next week nunchi Inter-District tournament start avthundi. Tickets easy ga dorukuthaayi, oka ₹50 nunchi ₹100 lope untaayi. Nee tickets ikkada online lo book chesukovachu: bookmyshow.com/ntr-stadium-cricket.

prompt: Macha, nenu recent ga PS5 konna. Twitch lo stream cheddam anukuntunna kani setup ela cheyyalo teliyatledu. Minimum equipment em kavali?
response: Abba, congratulations ra PS5 konnanduku! Twitch lo stream cheyyali ante basic ga neeku konni things kavali. Mundu oka good quality mic teeskondra, voice clear ga undali. Tarvatha, capture card okati kavali, ee card PS5 nunchi video signal ni PC ki transfer chestundi. PC lo OBS Studio install chesukoni, mic, capture card anni connect chesi settings adjust chesko. Konchem lighting bagunte inka better ga untundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu daily reels scroll chesthu chala time waste chesthunna. Ila kani istesanu ani anipisthundi. Ela control chesukovali?
response: Arey, adi common ra. Nuvvu app lo time limit set cheyyi. Instagram lo 'Your activity' loki velli daily time limit pettukondi. 30 mins, 45 mins ala. Tarvata adi notification isthundi, apudu close cheseyyali. Inka, phone ki 'do not disturb' mode activate cheyyi. Notifications thakkuva untay, less distraction.

prompt: Macha, next month Hyderabad degarra weekend trip ki veldam ani plan chesthunnam. Emaina bagunna places unte cheppava, konchem chill avvadaniki?
response: Sure ra! Hyderabad degarra weekend trip ki chaala manchi places unnayi chill avvadaniki. Nenu konni suggestions istha chusko:  1. **Nagarjuna Sagar:** Ikkada dam chaala baguntundi, boating cheyyachu. Adjacent ga Ethipothala waterfalls kuda untayi, nature lovers ki perfect. Konchem peace ga untundi.  2. **Ananthagiri Hills:** Vikarabad degarra untundi, chuttu greenery tho, trekking ki baguntundi. Resorts kuda untayi stay cheyyadaniki, so relax avvachu.  3. **Warangal:** Historical places ante istapadithe, Warangal manchi option. Kakatiya Kala Thoranam, Thousand Pillar Temple chudacchu. Konchem city vibe untundi.  4. **Srisailam:** Idhi religious place kuda, kani forest area chuttu untundi. Nallamala forest lo drive cheyyadam oka experience. Akkada dam kuda untundi.  Ee places anni kuda Hyderabad nunchi 3-4 hours drive lo untayi, so weekend ki perfect. Mundu ga booking chesukunte better.

prompt: Macha, ee month kharchulu chaala ekkuvayi poyayi. Salary vachina ventane credit card bill kattesi, inka em migalatledu. Konchem money save cheyyalante em cheyali, tips emaina cheppava?
response: Arey, idhi chaala common problem ra. Nenu cheppe oka simple tip enti ante, salary vachina ventane first savings ki konchem amount separate cheyyi. Alaa cheste credit card bills kattina, monthly expenses chesina tension undadu. Oka budget plan chesuko, andulo rent, food, transport lanti compulsory expenses anni list chesukuni, daily UPI transactions anni tracking lo pettuko. Taruvata entertainment lanti optional expenses ni konchem control cheste automatic ga money save avvadam start avtundi.

prompt: Macha, Flipkart lo order chesina mobile delivery delay avthundi. Already 5 days ayindi, tracker lo 'shipped' ani chupisthundi kani move avvatledu. Em cheyyali?
response: Arey, alaga? Ee madhya delivery issues ekkuva ayyay. Munduga Flipkart app lo ne 'Help Centre' section ki velli nee order number tho complaint raise chey. Kakapothe, direct ga customer support team ki call cheyadam best option. Vallu correct status cheppi, entha time padthundo cheptharu. Leda, konchem wait chesi, next 2 days lo kooda movement lekapothe, order cancel chesi vere shop lo teesko.

prompt: Macha, ee week antha chaala busy unta. Indulo inti pani asalu cheyyatledu. Ee saturday ki easy ga room ela clean cheyyalo cheppu, lekapothe amma nannu tittestundi.
response: Arey, tension padaku. Saturday ki ne room clean cheyyadaniki quick steps cheptha. Mundu ga, bed sheet clean di vey, pillow covers change cheyyi. Tarvatha, floor meeda unna anni stuff ni teesesi, drawers lo pettali, lekapothe closet loki netti padeseyyi. Tarvatha, dust undi unte oka cloth tho anni objects meeda nunchi tusseyyali. Last ga, vacuum cleaner undi unte oka sari floor clean cheyyi, lekapothe broom tho sweep chey. Oka half an hour lo clean aipotundi, amma ki kopam raadu.

prompt: Macha, ee madhya chaala stressed ga untunnanu ra. Office lo work pressure, personal ga konni issues, anni kalisi mind ki pattukuntunnayi. Ela handle cheyalo teliyatledu.
response: Arey, tension padaku ra. Prati okkariki ilantivi common. First, oka 15-20 minutes daily meditation cheyadaniki try chey. Appudu mind konchem calm avvuthundi. Taruvatha, neeku nachina hobbies emaina unte, avi chey. Friends tho bayataki velli enjoy chey, sports adu, ledante books chaduvu. Healthy food tinu, sarigga nidra po. Ee small changes chaala help chestayi.

prompt: Macha, ee weekend em plans levu. Mall ni vellamantara? Edaina offers unte chudochu kada.
response: Abba, super idea ra! Definitely veldam. Nenu Ninna konchem online lo chusa, City Center Mall lo Marks & Spencer lo koddiga discount sale undanta. Inka Westside lo kooda new collection vachindi ani talk. Food court lo kooda emaina try cheddam, let's meet up by 2 PM around the entrance.

prompt: Macha, next month nunchi semester exams start avthunnai. Ee sari marks chaala important. Naaku oka effective study plan cheppava? Syllabus chaala undi, time takkuva.
response: Arey, tension padaku. Time takkuva unna sarigga plan cheskunte easy ga manage cheyyochu. Mundu, nee subjects list cheyi, tarvatha each subject lo high-weightage topics identify chesko. Last year question papers chusi important areas meeda focus chey. Daily oka 2-3 hours dedicated ga chaduvu, breaks teeskuntu undu. Weekends lo difficult subjects ki ekkuva time allot chey. Late nights avoid chesi morning fresh ga start chey. Groups lo discuss chesi doubts clear cheskovadam manchidi. Ila cheste, easy ga exams prepare avvagalavu.

prompt: Macha, ippudu konni companies ki apply cheddam anukuntunna. Naa resume konchem old aindi, ela update cheyali? Mariyu interview ki emanna tips unnaya?
response: Arey, resume ni update cheyyadaniki konni important points chusko. Munduga, nee recent projects, accomplishments anni add chey. Power verbs vaadu, e.g., 'led', 'managed', 'developed' ani. Nee resume ni ATS-friendly ga cheskovadam important, so keywords use chey. Template clean ga, easy to read ga undali, oka page lo complete cheyadaniki try chey. Interview tips kosam, company gurinchi research chey, vallu em pani chestunnaro telusukovali. Common questions ki answers prepare chesuko, like 'tell me about yourself' or 'why do you want to work here'. Confidence ga matladu, eye contact maintain chey. All the best ra!

prompt: Macha, ee machine learning models ela work chesthayi? Konchem simple ga explain cheyyava, chudataniki chaala complex ga untunnayi.
response: Arey, machine learning models ante pedda rocket science em kadu ra. Basic ga, avi chala data nunchi patterns nerchukuntayi. Manam vaatiki peddaga data ichhi, 'ee picture lo dog undi, ee picture lo cat undi' ani cheptham. So, avi aa pictures lo unna features ni observe chesi, next time kothha picture chusinappudu adi dog aa, cat aa ani predict chesthayi. Training tarvata, kothha data ichina sare correct answers isthayi. Anthe, it's all about learning from examples.

prompt: Yaar, nenu okka simple Python function raasanu, kani output wrong vasthundi. Print chesi chusthe variables value correct ga undi, kani final result matram teda vasthundi. Em cheyalo teliyatledu.
response: Abba, ilantivi chaala common macha. Variables correct ga unna final result teda vasthundi ante, mainly logic lo error untundi. Nee function lo conditional statements (if/else) or loops (for/while) unte avi oka sari check chey. Boundary conditions handle chesthunnava ledha chusko. Oka sari small inputs tho manual ga calculate chesi, nee code em isthundo compare chey. Appudu error ekkado telustundi.

prompt: Macha, ee week naaku oka different recipe try cheyyali anukuntunna. Something traditional ga undali, mana Telugu cuisine lo easy ga cheskone di cheppava. Veg ayithe best.
response: Sure ra, easy ga undali, traditional ga undali, inka veg ante best option Gummadikaya Pulusu. Adi chaala flavourful ga untundi, and rice tho super combination. Cheyyadam kuda peddaga kastam em kadu. Gummadikaya pieces cut chesi, konchem chintapandu pulusu, karam, salt, bellam vesi udiginchi, last lo popu pedithey chalu. Oka 30-40 minutes lo ready aipotundi, easy ga chesko.

prompt: Macha, naku rendo pilladiki school admissions gurinchi konchem tension ga undi. First pilladiki problem lekunda ayindi kani, ippudu seats chaala competitive aipoyayi. Em cheyyali, oka idea ivvu please.
response: Arey, common ra. Ippudu admission season kada, andarki ade tension. Nuvvu konchem early ga start cheyyali. Mana area lo best schools em unnayo list chesko mundu. Tarvata vallu open cheyagane apply chey. Personal ga velli management ni kalisi, school culture ento adigi telusko. Sometimes, early registration ki benefits untayi. Tension padaku, pakka seat dorukutundi.

prompt: Macha, ma chinna coordinator ki marriage fix ayyindi. Ma intlo andaru oka mata meeda leru, andaru edoka opinion chepthunnaru. Veellandarini elaga convince cheyalo teliyatledu.
response: Arey, family lo ilantivi common ra. Andari suggestions ni mundu calm ga vinu. Tarvatha, nuvvu evarini marry chesukovali anukuntunnavo, aa person gurinchi positive points anni list chesko. Mee parents ki vaari gurinchi details cheppu, vaaru neeku entha importanto, nee future plan enti anedi clear ga explain chey. Konchem patience ga handle cheste, ninnu ardham cheskuntaru.

prompt: Macha, next month Bengaluru ki car lo road trip plan chesthunnam. First time, emanna tips unte cheppu, ela plan cheyali, em check cheyali?
response: Abba super idea ra! Bengaluru road trip ki mundu konni chusko. Mundu ga nee car ni service cheyinchu, tyres pressure, oil level, brake fluid anni check cheyinchu. Route Google Maps lo mundu ga check chesi, tolls, rest stops ekkada unnayo chusko. Aa tarvata, travel time entha padutundo chusi, konchem early ga start avvandi traffic avoid cheyadaniki. Night journey aithe driving ki comfort ga untundi. Snacks, water, power bank anni car lo ready ga petkondi. Emanna emergency kit unte inka manchidi.

prompt: Macha, ee madhya nenu fitness meeda focus cheddam anukuntunna. Gym ki vellali ani undi kani time set avvatledu. Edo oka simple daily routine cheppava intlone cheskodaniki?
response: Arey, gym ki vellakkarledu, intlone daily oka half an hour simple exercises cheste chalu. Morning lechaka oka 10 mins stretching cheyyi, tarvatha oka 15 mins plank, push-ups, squats alantivi oka 3 sets chey. Last lo oka 5 mins pranayama or deep breathing chesthe body refresh avtundi. Food kuda light ga tesko, healthy untav.

prompt: Macha, ee summer lo weather chaala worst ga undi kada? Temperature roju roju ki perugutundi, assalu bayataki vellalante bhayam vestundi.
response: Avunu ra, nenu kuda ade anukuntunna. Hyderabad lo ee saari heat wave chaala strong ga undi. Morning walk ki velladaniki kuda baya padtunnam. Intlo undi AC pettukovatam best. Hydration baga undela chusko, ledu ante full sunstroke vasthadi. Ee summer entha toondaraga ayipothe antha manchidi.

prompt: Macha, ee weekend cinema ki veldama? Recent ga emaina good movies vachhaya? Konchem review lu chusi cheppu.

prompt: Macha, ee week end cricket match undi ga? Mana local ground lo, time table emaina telusa neeku?
response: Oh avnu ra, ee sunday mana local ground lo match undi. Morning 10:30 ki start avuthundi. Mana team ee sari pakka gelavali, last time performance baundi. Nuvvu kuda ra, nenu vasthunna chuddam ki.

prompt: Macha, ee madhya chaala mandhi gaming videos chestunnaru kada YouTube lo. Mari, asalu game streaming ki minimum requirements enti, setup ela undali ani konchem clarity isthava?
response: Arey gaming stream cheyyadaniki basics cheptha chudu. First, oka powerful PC or laptop kavali, at least i5 processor, 16GB RAM, and a good graphics card like RTX 3060 undali. Tarvatha, fast internet connection must, at least 50Mbps upload speed unte lag lekunda stream cheyyochu. Oka good microphone and webcam kuda important, chat lo viewers ki quality sound and video bagundali kada. Stream chestunnappudu OBS Studio or Streamlabs OBS vadochu, ivi free software's. Final ga, oka second monitor unte stream chat chusukodaniki easy ga untundi.

prompt: Macha, naku konni funny meme ideas kavali, konchem relatable ga undali. Friends ki pampithe navvali. Instagram reels lo viral ayye typevi. WhatsApp status ki kuda use avvali.
response: Sure, macha! Nenu neeku konni killer meme ideas cheptha. Choodu, mostly students ki exams time lo nunchi, work from home distractions nunchi, leda konni relatable middle-class problems nunchi memes pedithe instant ga viral avuthayi. Aa 'Me at 3 AM' templates vaadi, rendu version of photos pettu, oka danilo 'Pani cheyyali' ani, inkodanilo 'Instagram reels chustunna' ani. Inka 'My brain when I need to focus' ani, daaniki konni random thoughts images add chey. WhatsApp status ki 'Me trying to explain my weekend plans to my boss' ani, daaniki confused animal expressions add chey. Ee ideas baguntayi pakka ga.

prompt: Macha, next month weekend ki goa plan chesthunna. Ekkada stay avvali, em chudali ani konchem ideas isthava? Budget around 15k undi okko person ki.
response: Oh ho, Goa ah! Super plan ra. 15k budget ki okko person ki ithe bagane manage cheyyochu. Stay ki North Goa lo Calangute, Baga beaches daggara chudu. Akkada chaala good hotels and resorts untayi, night life kuda active ga untundi. South Goa lo konchem peaceful ga untundi, Palolem side chudochu. Chudadaniki: Aguada Fort, Baga Beach, Calangute Beach, Anjuna Flea Market, Dudhsagar Falls. Water sports try cheyyi, parasailing, jet ski baguntayi. Night time beach shacks lo chill avvu. Bookings mundhe chesuko, late chesthe prices perugutayi.

prompt: Macha, salary vachindi kani every month dabbulu ekkadiki pothunnayo teliyatledu. Edo oka app use chesi expenses track cheddam anukuntunna. Suggest cheyyava edaina simple ga use cheyadaniki?
response: Arey, app good idea. Ee madhya chala unnayi. Oka simple app kosam ayithe Google Pay lo nee expenses chuskovachu. Andulo nee UPI transactions anni untayi kabatti clear ga kanipistayi. Inka konchem deep ga track cheyyali ante Moneyfy or Wallet by BudgetBakers try chey. Andulo nuvvu monthly rent, food, bills ani categories pettukuni entha kharchu chestunnavo chuskovachu. Nee credit card bills kuda ekkada track chestunnavo app lo add chesko. Appudu savings goal ento kooda clear ga telustundi kada.

prompt: Macha, nenu Amazon nunchi oka new phone order chesa, kaani delivery late avutundi. Tracker lo delivery date change ayyindi. Customer support tho ela matladali? Fast ga reply ravali ante em cheyali?
response: Arey, nee phone delivery late avthunda? No problem, nenu cheptha ela cheyalo. Mundu Amazon app lo order details loki velli, 'Contact Seller' or 'Get Help' option chudu. Akkada delivery delay gurinchi mention chesi, tracker lo change ayyina date detail ga cheppu. Vaalu mostly 24 hours lo reply istharu. Eeroju kaakapothe repu morning malli call chey customer care ki, call lo matladithe inka fast ga response vastundi.

prompt: Macha, ee week antha office work tho saripoyindi. Room chaala mess aipoindi. Weekend cleaning ki emaina simple tips cheppava, ekkuva time pattakunda?
response: Arey, weekend cleaning ki first anni unwanted papers, junk mottam dustbin lo padeseyyi. Tarvatha bedsheet change chesi, pillows sarigga pettu. Shelf meeda books anni neat ga arrange chey. Floor broom chesi, okasari mop chesthe chalu, fresh ga untundi room. Maximum one hour lo aipoipotundi.

prompt: Macha, office lo work pressure chaala ekkuva aipoindi. Weekend kuda relax avvalekapothunna. Ee stress ni ela handle cheyalo ardham kavatledu.
response: Arey, work stress common ra. First thing, nee schedule konchem manage chesko. Prati weekend oka specific time lo phone, laptop pakkana petti, neeku istamaina pani chey. Friends tho bayataki vellu, cinema choodu, ledha family tho time spend chey. Konchem exercise cheyadam, meditation cheyadam kuda baaga help chestundi. Work hours lo breaks teesko, chinna walk vellu. Konchem konchem try cheste set aipotundi, tension padaku.

prompt: Macha, ee weekend em plans? Kothaga emaina place ki veldama leka usual ga movie, food aa?
response: Arey, weekend ki inka em decide cheyyaledu ra. Movie and food bore kottindi. Edo kothadi cheddam. Jubilee Hills lo oka new cafe open ayyindi anta, akkadiki veldama? Lekapothe, konchem shopping cheddam anukuntunna, discounts unnayi anta. Emantav, kothaga cafe try cheddama leka shopping chesi bore kottesi intiki vellipodama?

prompt: Macha, ee semester exams mundu chaala tension ga undi. Mana college library lo group study sessions emaina untaya, idea unda? And naa chemistry assignments anni backlogs unnayi, ela complete cheyyali?
response: Arey, tension padaku ra. Mana library lo exams mundu definitely group study sessions untayi, notice board meeda details chudu. Lekapothe library staff ni adigina cheptaru. Chemistry assignments ki, mundu easy topics nunchi start chey. Rojuki oka ganta time petti oka assignment complete cheyadaniki try chey. Edaina topic ardam kakapothe nannu adugu, nenu help chestha. Kalisi kurchuni koddiga assignments finish cheddam le, don't worry.

prompt: Macha, nenu resume update cheyyali ani chusthunna, kani em add cheyyalo teliyatledu. Konni points cheppava, jobs ki apply cheyyadaniki help avuthundi.
response: Arey, resume update cheyyadaniki nee recent projects clear ga add chey. Enthaku mundu work lo em achievements unnayo numbers tho highlight chey. Skills section lo latest technologies em nerchukunnayo mention chey. Mariyu, nee resume ni job profile ki taggattu customise cheskunte chala better untundi, general ga okate resume ivvakunda. Konchem time teesko, baaga research chesi update chey. All the best!

prompt: Macha, ee AI models ela train chestharu ra? Naku entha explain chesina sarigga ardam kavatledu, simple ga cheppu.
response: Arey, simple ga cheppalante, AI models ni chaala data tho train chestharu. Imagine chey, oka pillavadiki chaala pictures chupinchi 'idi dog, idi cat' ani nerpinchadam laga. Data ni model ki feed chesi, adi pattern ni recognize cheyadam nerchukuntundi. Ee process lo model chaala sarlu mistakes chestundi, danni correct chesthu, inka data tho train chesthu untaru. Ikkada data ante images avvochu, text avvochu, ledha sounds avvochu. Ila cheyadam valla adi correct ga predict cheyagalugutundi anamata.

prompt: Macha, nenu git lo konchem work chesa, kani ippudu `git push` chesthe `non-fast-forward` error vasthundi. Ela fix cheyalo ardham avvatledu, help chey ra.
response: Arey, adi common issue ra. Neeku `non-fast-forward` error ostundi ante, neeku mundu vere changes remote repository lo unnayani meaning. Adi fix cheyyadaniki mundu `git pull --rebase` chey. Appudu remote lo unna changes neeku merge aipotayi. Tarvatha nuvvu fresh ga `git push` cheskovachu. Idi chaala simple ga solve ayipotundi.

prompt: Macha, naku first time chicken biryani cheyyali ani undi. Ee recipe konchem difficult antaru, kani nenu try cheddam anukuntunna. Edaina simple method unda, beginners ki easy ga ardamayyela?
response: Abba, chicken biryani easy ne ra. First, chicken ni marinate cheyali – allam-vellulli paste, karam, pasupu, dhaniya powder, garam masala, konchem perugu, nimma rasam pindi oka half hour. Tarvata oka big pot lo oil vesi onions fry chey, golden brown ayyaka marianted chicken add chey. Oka 10-15 mins cooked ayyaka, rice ni add chey (rice ni already half-cooked chesi pettuko). Ippudu konchem water, uppu, pudina, kothimeera pindi. Dum ki petti oka 20 mins slow flame meeda cook cheste chalu. Nuvvu super ga chesthav, tension padaku!

prompt: Macha, na pillalu okarinokaru kottukuntunnaru, chaala frustration vasthundi. Ela manage cheyyalo asalu teliyatledu.
response: Ayyo, idhi chala common ra. First, vaalla iddariki separate time spend cheyyi, vaalla hobbies gurinchi matladu. Tarvatha, vaalliddariki common games, activities introduce chey, appudu kalisi aadukuntaru. Chinna chinna arguments ni light ga teesko, peddavi aite matram okari maatalu okaru vinedi try cheyamani cheppu. Konchem Geddam ga behave cheyyakunda patience tho handle cheyyali.

prompt: Macha, next month cousin marriage undi. Em gifts ivvalo idea ravatledu. Edo okati cheppu ra, konchem creative ga undali.
response: Arey, cousin marriage ki gifts ante konchem thoughtful ga undali. Money ivvadam common. Meeru oka good quality kitchen appliance ivvochu, like air fryer or stand mixer. prompt: Macha, AI model ni train cheyyadam ante exact ga em chestharu? Aa process ela untadi asalu?
response: Arey, AI model ni train cheyyadam ante basic ga daniki chaala data ni feed chesi nerpistharu. Ila cheyadam valla model inka accurate ga predictions cheyyagalugutundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu oka chinna web app chesthunna, Python Flask tho. Oka form submit chesinappudu database lo data store cheyali. SQLite vaduthunna. Ela cheyalo oka simple snippet isthava?
response: Sure ra, Flask app lo form data SQLite lo store cheyadaniki oka simple way cheptha. Mundu Flask, SQLAlchemy install chesuko. Tarvatha, `app.py` lo ilanti code add chey:```pythonfrom flask import Flask, render_template, requestfrom flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemyapp = Flask(__name__)app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///site.db'db = SQLAlchemy(app)class User(db.Model):    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)    def __repr__(self):        return f'<User {self.username}>'@app.route('/register', methods=['GET', 'POST'])def register():    if request.method == 'POST':        username = request.form['username']        email = request.form['email']        new_user = User(username=username, email=email)        db.session.add(new_user)        db.session.commit()        return 'User registered successfully!'    return render_template('register.html')if __name__ == '__main__':    with app.app_context():        db.create_all()    app.run(debug=True)```Idhi `site.db` ane file lo nee database create chestundi. `register.html` lo oka simple form pettuko. Adi POST request tho data ni `username` and `email` fields lo pampistundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu recent ga oka small project start chesa. Python lo data analysis ki Pandas library use chestunna. Basic ga CSV file nundi data read chesi, konni columns select chesi, filter cheyali. Simple code snippet chupinchagalava?
response:
Sure ra, Pandas use chesi CSV read chesi, columns select chesi, filter cheyyadam chala easy. Ee sample code chudu, neeku help avvachu:

```python
import pandas as pd

# CSV file read cheyyadam
df = pd.read_csv('your_data.csv')

# Specific columns select cheyyadam
selected_columns_df = df[['ColumnA', 'ColumnB', 'ColumnC']]

# Data filter cheyyadam (example: ColumnA value 100 kanna ekkuva unna rows)
filtered_df = selected_columns_df[selected_columns_df['ColumnA'] > 100]

print("Original Dataframe head:")
print(df.head())

print("\nSelected Columns Dataframe head:")
print(selected_columns_df.head())

print("\nFiltered Dataframe head:")
print(filtered_df.head())
```

`your_data.csv` place lo nee file name pettu. `ColumnA`, `ColumnB`, `ColumnC` avi nee CSV lo unna column names tho marchu. Emi doubt unna adugu.

prompt: Macha, database nunchi data teyyataniki chaala queries unnayi. Emaina quick ga common ga vaade SQL queries list cheyava, beginners ki easy ga undela?
response: Sure ra, database nunchi data retrieve cheyyataniki common ga vaade SQL queries ikkada unnayi. Ivi chala basic vi, nee ki easy ga untayi:  1. **SELECT Statement:** `SELECT column1, column2 FROM table_name;` Itho nuvvu select chesina columns ni table nunchi teeskosthav. Anni columns kavali ante `*` vaadu.  2. **WHERE Clause:** `SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE condition;` Itho nuvvu oka specific condition ki match ayye rows ni filter cheyyachu.  3. **ORDER BY Clause:** `SELECT * FROM table_name ORDER BY column_name ASC|DESC;` Itho nuvvu data ni ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order lo arrange cheyyachu.  4. **INSERT Statement:** `INSERT INTO table_name (column1, column2) VALUES (value1, value2);` Itho nuvvu table lo kotha data add cheyyachu.  5. **UPDATE Statement:** `UPDATE table_name SET column1 = value1 WHERE condition;` Itho nuvvu exist ayina data ni change cheyyachu.  6. **DELETE Statement:** `DELETE FROM table_name WHERE condition;` Itho nuvvu table nunchi specific rows ni delete cheyyachu.  Ivi basics, ivanni nuvvu practies cheyyi, inka easy ga vastadi.

prompt: Macha, nenu oka chinna web app chesthunna, Python Flask vaadi. Okka simple database create cheyyali, users details save cheyyadaniki. Ela cheyalo oka simple example cheppu.
response: Flask lo database use cheyyali ante SQLite chala easy. Flask-SQLAlchemy extension vaadithe inka simple ga untundi. Mundu `pip install Flask-SQLAlchemy` chey. Tarwata ila code rayali.  ```python from flask import Flask from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy  app = Flask(__name__) app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///site.db' db = SQLAlchemy(app)  class User(db.Model):     id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)     username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)     email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)      def __repr__(self):         return f'<User {self.username}>'  @app.route('/') def index():     return 'Hello, Flask App!'  if __name__ == '__main__':     with app.app_context():         db.create_all()     app.run(debug=True) ``` Ee code lo, `site.db` ani oka database file create avtundi. `User` model lo `id`, `username`, `email` fields untayi. `db.create_all()` tho tables create cheyyachu. Ippudu nuvvu users ni add cheyyadaniki `db.session.add(new_user)` vaadali.

prompt: Macha, ee week end intlo vanta cheddam anukuntunna. First time biryani try cheddam ani plan. Em ingredients kavali, step-by-step process chepthe baguntadi. Chicken biryani cheddam ani.
response: Abba, chicken biryani ah! Super plan. Ikkadi ingredients list plus process cheptha chudu.  Basic ga ee items stock chesko:  *   **Chicken**: 1 kg, medium pieces  *   **Basmati Rice**: 750 grams  *   **Onions**: 3-4 peddavi, slice chesuko  *   **Tomatoes**: 2-3, chop chesuko  *   **Green Chillies**: 4-5, slice chesuko  *   **Ginger-Garlic Paste**: 2 tbsp  *   **Curd (Perugu)**: 1 cup  *   **Biryani Masala**: 2 tbsp (ready made powder use cheyyochu)  *   **Red Chilli Powder**: 1 tbsp  *   **Turmeric Powder (Pasupu)**: 1/2 tsp  *   **Garam Masala**: 1 tsp  *   **Coriander Powder**: 1 tsp  *   **Mint Leaves (Pudina)**: Koddiga  *   **Coriander Leaves (Kothimeera)**: Koddiga  *   **Oil/Ghee**: Cooking ki saripada  *   **Salt**: Taste ki taggattu  *   **Whole Spices**: Bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom.   **Process idhe chudu:**  1.  **Rice soak chey**: Basmati rice ni 30 mins mundu clean chesi water lo soak chesi pettu.  2.  **Chicken Marinate chey**: Oka pedda bowl lo chicken, ginger-garlic paste, curd, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, biryani masala, garam masala, salt, koddiga pudina, kothimeera, konchem oil vesi mix chesi minimum 1-2 hours fridge lo pettu. Night antha marinate chesthe inka baguntadi.  3.  **Biryani prepare chey**:  *   Oka deep bottom pot lo oil/ghee vesi garam chey. Whole spices vesi fry chey.  *   Tarvatha sliced onions vesi golden brown ayyevaraku fry chey. Konchem onions garnishing ki teesukoni pakkana pettu.  *   Green chillies, chopped tomatoes vesi soft ayyevaraku cook chey.  *   Marinated chicken ni add chesi high flame meeda 5-7 mins cook chey, appudappudu stir chesthu. Tarvatha flame medium chesi 10-15 mins cook chey, chicken half-done ayyevaraku.  *   Parallel ga inkoka pot lo water boil chey rice kosam. Water lo salt, konchem oil, whole spices (optional) vesi boil chey.  *   Soak chesina rice ni drain chesi boiling water lo vesi 70% cook ayyevaraku boil chey. Daani tarvatha water drain chesi rice ni chicken meeda layer ga vey.  *   Rice meeda fried onions, chopped pudina, kothimeera chop chesi vey.  *   Pot ni lid tho close chesi, daani meeda edaina heavy object petti, low flame meeda 15-20 mins 'dum' chey.  *   20 mins tarvatha flame off chesi, 10 mins alaane vadiley.  4.  **Serve chey**: Gently mix chesi raita tho serve chesko.  Konchem lengthy process kani taste matram adhurs untadi. All the best!

prompt: Yaar, nenu naa new feature kosam code raasina. Git push chesthunte 'rejected non-fast-forward' ani error vasthundi. Em cheyyalo ardam avvatledu, naaku konchem simple ga explain cheyagalava?
response: Abba, aa 'rejected non-fast-forward' error common ra. Adhi enduku vasthundi ante, neeku teliyakundane evaro remote repository lo already changes push chesaru. If konni conflicts vasthe avi manually fix cheyali, lekapothe clean ga push cheyochu.

Resolve chesaka `git add .` ani, taruvatha `git commit -m "Fixed merge conflict"` ani chesi commit chey, appudu merge complete avtundi.

prompt: Mama, nenu project work chesthunna, two different branches unnayi – 'feature-A' and 'development'. 'feature-A' lo code raasa, ippudu 'development' branch lo merge cheyyali, kani conflicts vasthunnayi. Ela resolve cheyyali, oka simple workflow cheppu?
response:
Arey, conflicts vachhinappudu em tension padaku. Idi common thing. Simple ga ila chey: 

1.  **Switch to `development` branch**: Mundu nuvvu `development` branch lo ki maarali. `git checkout development` ani type chey.

2.  **Pull latest changes**: Tarvata, `development` branch lo latest updates emaina unte avi pull chesuko. `git pull origin development`.

3.  **Merge `feature-A` into `development`**: Ippudu `feature-A` branch ni `development` lo merge chey. `git merge feature-A`.

4.  **Resolve Conflicts**: Ekkada conflicts unnayo git neeku chupisthundi. Files ni open chesi, `<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>` markers vaddi nuvvu kavalsina code ni keep chesko. Migilinavi delete chey. Neeku kavalsina final code untundi anthe.

5.  **Add Resolved Files**: Conflicts resolve chesina tarvata, files ni stage chey. `git add <conflicted_file_name>`.

6.  **Commit Changes**: Last ga, nee changes ni commit chey. `git commit -m "Merged feature-A into development and resolved conflicts"`.

Idhi cheste nee conflicts anni resolve aipotayi. Emaina doubt vasthe malli adugu.

prompt: Macha, nenu oka small project chettha. Python lo list of dictionaries undi, daanlo employees details unnayi. Konni dictionaries status 'Active' ani untayi, konni 'Inactive' ani. Nenu 'Active' status unna employees ni matrame filter cheyyali. Ela cheyyalo oka simple code snippet chupinchava?
response:
Arey, easy ga cheyyochu ra. Python lo list comprehension vaadi simple ga filter cheyyochu. Oka example code chudu:

```python
employees = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Ravi", "status": "Active"},
    {"id": 2, "name": "Suresh", "status": "Inactive"},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Priya", "status": "Active"},

]

active_employees = [employee for employee in employees if employee["status"] == "Active"]

print(active_employees)
```

Ee code run chesthe, 'Active' status unna employees matrame print avtharu.

prompt: Bro, naku chaala rojula nunchi authentic Chettinad chicken curry tinnalani undi. Hyderabad lo evaru chestaro teliyadu. Intlone cheddam anukuntunna kani naku Chettinad masalala gurinchi peddaga idea ledu. Konchem easy ga, perfect taste tho cheyyadaniki recipe cheppava?
response:
Hey Bro, Chettinad chicken curry chaala tasty ga untundi kada! Nu intlone easy ga cheyyochu. Main ga Chettinad masalane important. Ee recipe try chey, taste super untundi:

**Ingredients:**
* Chicken: 500 grams (pieces ga cut cheskovali)
* Onions: 2 medium (sanna ga cut cheskovali)
* Tomatoes: 2 medium (purée cheskovali)
* Ginger Garlic Paste: 1 tbsp
* Curry Leaves: Konni
* Oil: 3-4 tbsp
* Salt: Taste ki saripada

**Chettinad Masala ki:**
* Dry Red Chillies: 6-8 (nee karam batti)
* Coriander Seeds: 2 tbsp
* Cumin Seeds: 1 tsp
* Fennel Seeds (Sounf): 1 tsp
* Black Peppercorns: 1 tsp
* Cardamom (Elaichi): 3-4
* Cloves (Lavangalu): 4-5
* Cinnamon (Dalchin chekka): 1-inch piece
* Grated Coconut (or dry coconut): 2 tbsp (optional, kani taste bauntundi)

**Ela Cheyyali:**
1.  **Masala Prepare Cheyyadam:** Oka pan lo konchem oil lekunda, masala ingredients anni (coconut thappa) low flame meeda smell vacche varaku fry chey. Tarwatha coconut add chesi, light ga fry chey. Cool ayyaka grinder lo konchem water add chesi smooth paste laga grind chesko.
2.  **Chicken Marinate Cheyyadam:** Chicken ki konchem salt, turmeric, inka konchem masala paste patti oka 15-20 mins pakkana pettukovali.
3.  **Curry Cheyyadam:** Oka heavy bottom pan lo oil vesi garam ayyaka, curry leaves vesi fry chey. Tarwatha onions add chesi golden brown ayye varaku fry chey. Ginger garlic paste vesi raw smell poye varaku fry chey.
4.  **Tomato Purée & Chicken:** Tomato purée add chesi oil separate ayye varaku fry chey. Ippudu marinate chesina chicken add chesi, high flame meeda 5-7 mins fry chey.
5.  **Masala Add Cheyyadam:** Grind chesina Chettinad masala paste ni add chesi, chicken tho kalipi 2-3 mins fry chey. Konchem water (grinder lo masala migilipoyinte adhe water add chey) add chesi, salt adjust cheskovali.
6.  **Simmer Cheyyadam:** Lid petti low flame meeda chicken soft ayye varaku, gravy thick ayye varaku oka 20-25 mins cook chey. Madya madya lo kaluputu undali.

Ready ayyaka hot hot rice tho or parotta tho serve chey. Perfect Chettinad taste vastundi!

prompt: Macha, nenu oka new feature develop chesi, main branch ki merge cheddam ani choosthunna. Kani konni files lo merge conflicts vasthunnayi. Ee conflicts ni git lo ela resolve cheyali, step by step cheppu please?
response:
Yaar, git conflicts resolve cheyadam pedda pani em kadu. Neeku steps cheptha chudu:

1.  **`git status` chudu:** Mundu `git status` ani type chesi, em files conflict ayyayo chudu. Avi "both modified" ani untayi.
2.  **Conflict files open chey:** Ee files ni nee code editor lo open chey. Conflicting sections lo `<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>` markers untayi. `<<<<<<< HEAD` ante nee current branch lo unna code, `=======` kindha `>>>>>>> [branch name]` ante nuvvu merge cheyyabotunna branch nunchi vachina code.
3.  **Changes decide chey:** Ee markers madhya unna code lo, neeku edi kavalo adi retain cheyali. Rendu changes kavalante, rendu kalupukoni rakkochu. Markers ni delete chesi, correct final code ni matrame unchu.
4.  **`git add` chey:** Changes save chesina tharvatha, `git add <file-name>` ani kottu. Ee step tho nuvvu conflict resolve chesanu ani git ki chepthunnav.
5.  **`git commit` chey:** Anni conflicts resolve chesi, add chesina tharvatha, `git commit -m "Resolve merge conflicts"` ani kottu. Commit message ni neeku ardham ayyela unchu.

Idi chesaka, nee merge complete ayipotundi. Next time nunchi pull cheyyadaniki mundu `git pull --rebase` try chey, conflicts konchem thakkuva avvocchu.

Next time gym ki vellinappudu, workout mundu warm-up, taruvatha cool-down exercises cheyyadam marchipoku. Slowly intensify chey, sudden ga heavy weights lift cheyyaku.

prompt: Bro, nenu loops gurinchi nerchukuntunna Python lo. While loops, for loops ardam ayyayi kani nested loops konchem confusion ga undi. Simple ga oka nested loop example cheppava, output tho saha.
response:
Hey Bro, nested loops ante oka loop lopala inkoka loop ante. Simple ga, oka outer loop ki prathi iteration lo, inner loop moththam run avtundi. Nenu oka simple example chepta, stars print cheyyadaniki:

```python
for i in range(3):  # Outer loop for rows (0, 1, 2)
    for j in range(3):  # Inner loop for columns (0, 1, 2)
        print("*"),
    print("") # Next line ki velladaniki
```

Ee code run cheste output ila vastundi:

```
* * *
* * *
* * *
```

Ikkada, outer loop 'i' 0 nunchi 2 varaku vastundi. Prati 'i' value ki, inner loop 'j' 0 nunchi 2 varaku run avtundi. So, 'i=0' unnappudu, 'j' 0, 1, 2 run avtundi, 3 stars print avtayi. Tarvata next line ki vellipoye function untundi. Tarvata 'i=1' avtundi, malli 'j' 0, 1, 2 run avtundi, inko 3 stars print avtayi. Ala sagipotundi.

prompt: Macha, ee quantum computing ante asalu enti ra? Nenu sci-fi movies lo chustha, kani real life lo ela work chestundo ardham avvatledu. Konchem simple ga explain cheyagalava?
response: Yaar, quantum computing ante regular computers laga kakunda, chaala advanced concept. Mana normal computers data ni bits (0 or 1) lo store chesthayi kada, quantum computers "qubits" vaadathayi. Ee qubits 0, 1, rendu okesaari (superposition) lo undagalavu. So, same time lo chaala calculations cheyyagalavu, which makes them super powerful for certain problems. Future lo medicines develop cheyyadaniki, financial market analysis ki inka complex scientific simulations ki chaala useful avthundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu oka Java application develop chesthunna. Code run chesthunappudu chala memory leak avthundi ani anipisthundi. Ela debug cheyyalo konchem idea isthava?

JConsole or VisualVM vaadi heap usage and garbage collection activity chusko. Oka snapshot teesukoni, classes and objects em ekkuva memory consume chesthunnayo chudali. Edaina long-lived objects strong references tho leak avthunnayo check chey. Resources (like database connections, file streams) close chestunnava leda chusko, often adi main problem untundi.

prompt: Bro, nenu JavaScript lo oka simple function rasthunna, kani syntax error ani vasthundi ra. Console lo 'Unexpected token' ani chupisthundi. Code lo ekkada problem undho ardham avvatledu. Ela debug cheyyali?
response: Hey Bro, 'Unexpected token' ani ante mostly parentheses `()`, curly braces `{}`, square brackets `[]` or quotes `''/""` miss ayyi untayi ledha open chesi close cheyyadam marchipoyi untav. Nee code lo function arguments, object definitions, array declarations, or string literals ekkada unnayo chusko. Oka open bracket ki corresponding close bracket undha ledha check chey. Ledha oka extra comma ledha semicolon add chesi untav. Code editor lo syntax highlighting chusko, problem line highlight ayyi untundi. Adhi correct cheste problem solve avtundi.

prompt: Bro, nenu Vijayawada nunchi Tirupati ki overnight sleeper bus lo vellali anukuntunna. First time, so konchem tips cheppava. Journey comfortable ga undali ante emanna cheyyala?
response:
Hey Bro, Vijayawada nunchi Tirupati overnight bus journey ki konni tips cheptha chudu:

1.  **Ticket Booking:** Munduga ticket book chesko, especially window side sleeper berth aithe fresh air untundi. RTC bus aithe advance reservation best. Private buses lo convenience untundi.
2.  **Light Luggage:** Small backpack teeskellu, easy ga manage cheyyadaniki. Big luggage aithe compartment lo pettali.
3.  **Warm Clothes:** Bus lo AC full ga untundi, so oka light blanket leda jacket teeskellu, challaga undakunda. Konchem cold feeling undadu.
4.  **Snacks & Water:** Oka water bottle, inka konni light snacks like biscuits, fruits teeskellu. Bus stop lo konakkunte time save avtundi.
5.  **Entertainment:** Headset inka mobile lo movies leda music download cheskoni vellu. Time pass avtundi, bore kottadu.
6.  **Neck Pillow:** Chinna neck pillow teeskellu. Sleeper lo padukunnappudu support ga untundi, melakuva raadu. Comfort ga padukuntav.
7.  **Toilet Break:** Driver ni adigi, bus stops lo restroom break teesko. Bus lo undavu kabatti, munduga check chesko.

Eppudu bus ekkadaniki mundu correct bus number inka berth number check chesko. Happy journey!

```sql
FROM Products

```

Arey, Vizag lo fog chaala common. Bayapadaku, konni simple tips follow avvu:  
1. **Headlights use chey:** Low beam headlights mandatory ga on chey, high beam fog lo reverse effect istundi.  
2. **Fog lights vaadali:** Nee car ki fog lights unte, avi use cheyyali. Ivi visibility improve chestayi.  
3. **Speed tagginchu:** Chaala slow ga drive cheyyali, sudden brakes avoid chey.  
4. **Distance maintain chey:** Mundu velle car ki, nee car ki madhya chaala distance maintain cheyyali, emergency lo brake veyyadaniki time untundi.  
5. **Hazard lights:** Fog chaala thick ga unnapudu hazard lights veskondi, venaka nunchi vache vallaki nee car kanipistundi.  
6. **Horn use chey:** Avsaram unte slow ga horn use chey, pakkana vallaki nee presence telustundi.

prompt: Macha, next month APPSC Group 2 exam undi kada. Naaku four subjects unnayi, history, economy, polity and current affairs. Naaku konchem strategy kavali, ela time distribute cheyyali, oka weekly schedule emaina cheppava?
response:
Arey, APPSC Group 2 exams ki time distribute cheyyadam chaala important. Ee plan follow ayyuko, konchem easy avthundi:

**Day 1 (Monday):**
*   Morning: History (Ancient & Medieval History topics - 2 hours)
*   Evening: Current Affairs (Last one month updates - 1.5 hours)

Prati subject ki daily two slots allot cheyyi, one morning and one evening. Current affairs daily chusko, Newspaper or magazines nundi. Revision ki weekend dedicate cheyyi, practice exams chaala important. Exam mundu atleast 2-3 full-length mock tests raayadam marchipoku.

Macha, Sankranti panduga ki intlo pulihora cheyyali ani fix ayyam. Kani nenu ippati varaku peddaga cheyyaledu. Chaala authentic ga, delicious ga ravalante em em tips follow avvali? Process konchem detail ga cheptava?
response:
Yaar, Sankranti ki pulihora naa? Super choice! Authentic ga ravalante ee tips follow avvu:  

**Ingredients:**
* **Rice:** Konchem old rice vaadithe podi podiga vasthundi. New rice ithe sticky avvochu.
* **Chintapandu Guddha (Tamarind pulp):** Quality chintapandu teesukoni, konchem warm water lo nanalettesi, thick pulp teeyi. Idi main flavour.
* **Pulihora Pindi (Pulihora powder):** Chaala mandhi readymade vaadathaaru, kani intlo cheskunte inka taste ga untundi. Senaga pappu, minapa pappu, dhaniyalu, jeelakarra, endu mirchi, konchem menthulu anni oil lekunda fry chesi powder cheskovali. 

**Process:**
1. **Rice Cook Cheyyadam:** Rice ni okadaniki rendu water vesi, podi podiga cook chey. Cook ayyaka, ventane oka wide plate loki transfer chesi spread cheyyi. Konchem challarani, appude sticky avvadu.  
2. **Tadka Preparations:** Oka pan lo oil heat chesi, senaga pappu, minapa pappu, palli (peanuts), aavalu, jeelakarra, endu mirchi, pachhi mirchi, karivepaaku inka hing (inguva) vesi baaga fry chey. Palli baaga fry avvali, appude crunchy ga untayi. 
3. **Pulihora Mix:** Rice challaraka, daaniki mundu ready cheskunna tamarind pulp, sareintha uppu, pasupu inka nee homemade pulihora pindi (or store-bought) add chey. Ippudu ready cheskunna tadka ni kuda add chesi, chetitho gentle ga mix chey. Rice break avvakunda chusko.  
4. **Resting Time:** Mix chesina taruvatha, konchem sepu adhi settle avvanivvu. Appude flavours anni rice ki baaga pattukuntayi. Oka 15-20 minutes alane vadileyyi.  

Idi easy method ra, ee sari Sankranti ki pulihora super hit avthundi chudu!

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu Python lo lists tho work chesthunna. Oka list lo numbers unnayi, daanlo duplicate numbers ni teesi, unique numbers matrame unchela choodali. Ela cheyyalo oka simple method cheppava?
response:
Yaar, Python lo duplicates remove cheyyadaniki chaala easy method undi. Just list ni set loki convert chesi, malli list loki marchali anthe. Set ki unique elements matrame store chese capacity undi kabatti, duplicates auto ga remove aipothayi. Choodu, ee snippet try chey:

```python
my_list = [1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 1]
unique_numbers = list(set(my_list))
print(unique_numbers)
```

Output: `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` idi random order lo untundi. If order kuda maintain cheyyali ante, konchem different approach vaadali, kani unique numbers kosam idi best.

prompt: Macha, next month naaku GRE exam undi ra. Nenu Quantitative section lo chala weak ga unna, inka time kuda chaala takkuva. Konchem important topics emunnayo cheppi, ela prepare avvalo cheppava? Score konchem decent ga vasthe chalu ra.
response:
Arey, GRE Quantitative section ki prepare avvadaniki konni important topics untayi. Vere subjects ni pakkana petti, ee topics meeda concentrate cheyyi:

1.  **Arithmetic:** Number properties, percentages, ratios, averages, and exponents.
2.  **Algebra:** Linear equations, quadratic equations, inequalities, functions, and word problems.
3.  **Geometry:** Lines and angles, triangles, quadrilaterals, circles, and 3D shapes. Formulas anni baga chusko.
4.  **Data Analysis:** Statistics (mean, median, mode, standard deviation), probability, and data interpretation (graphs, tables).

Prepare avvadaniki ee tips follow avvu:

*   **Concept Clarity:** Munduga basic concepts ni baga ardham chesko. Edaina topic weak ga unte, first daani basics meeda focus cheyyi.
*   **Practice, Practice, Practice:** Official ETS material, Manhattan Prep, Kaploan lanti books lo unde practice questions anni solve cheyyi. Especially Quantitative Comparison and Data Interpretation questions ni baga practice cheyyali.
*   **Time Management:** Each question ki specific time limit petkoni practice cheyyi. Mock tests teeskoni time management ni improve chesuko.
*   **Error Log:** Mistakes chesina questions ni separate ga rasukoni, enduku tappu ayyindo analyse cheyyi. Future lo avi repeat avvakunda chusko.
*   **Flashcards:** Important formulas, theorems, and shortcuts ni flashcards la prepare cheskoni, regular ga revise cheyyi.

Ee short duration lo anni topics perfect cheyyadam kastam, kani eee core areas meeda concentrate chesthe decent score easy ga tegalugu.

prompt: Macha, next month Hyderabad nunchi Pondicherry ki bus lo vellali ani plan chesthunna. Trip budget ela set chesukovali, em expenses cover cheyyalo konchem idea isthava?
response:
Oi, Pondicherry trip ah, super idea! Bus lo veltunnav kabatti transport cost konchem thakkuva untundi. Budget set chesukovadaniki chala easy tips unnayi chusko:

1.  **Transport Cost:** Hyderabad nunchi Pondicherry ki bus fares mundu book cheskunte konchem cheap ga dorukutai. One way ki around ₹1200-₹1500 untundi. Round trip ki ₹3000 max anuko.
2.  **Accommodation:** Akkada Hotels or Homestays chala unnayi. Daily ki ₹1000-₹2500 varaku manchi options dorukutai. Mee budget batti booking.com or MakeMyTrip lo check chey. Oka 3 days plan chesthe ₹3000-₹7500 pettochu.
3.  **Food & Drinks:** Pondicherry lo food chala baguntundi, especially French cuisine. Daily ki food ki minimum ₹700-₹1000 anuko. 3 days ki ₹2100-₹3000.
4.  **Sightseeing & Activities:** Auroville, Paradise Beach, Promenade Beach lanti places ki entry fees takkuva untundi. Konni boat rides or water sports ki extra pay cheyyali. Overall, activities ki ₹1500-₹2000 pettochu.
5.  **Miscellaneous:** Konni unexpected expenses untayi kada, like souvenirs konadam, auto fares, emergency kosam oka ₹1000-₹1500 pakka pettuko.

So, rough ga oka 3 days trip ki minimum ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 varaku avochhu. Mundu bookings cheskunte money save avtundi. Enjoy chey trip!

prompt: Macha, nenu chaala rojula nunchi baaga savings cheyali ani anukuntunna kani avvatledu. Monthly salary vachinappudu first one week chaala happy ga untundi, entho konukkovaali anipisthundi. 1.  **Budget Set chesuko:** First, nee salary lo entha rent ki, bills ki, groceries ki pothundo chusko. Migilina daantlo food ki inka shopping ki oka fixed amount separate chesko. Aa limit daatakunda plan cheyyali.
2.  **Meal Planning cheyyi:** Oka week mundu nee food plan ready chesko. Intlo em chesthav, bayata em tintav clear ga undali. Ila cheste unnecessary ga bayata order cheyyadam tagguthundi.
3.  **Groceries Konukkoni Fridge lo pettuko:** Intlo ingredients unte bayata nunchi order chese necessity tagguthundi. Fast ga cook chesevi, snacks ready ga unchu.
4.  **Want vs Need differentiate cheyyi:** Shopping chese mundu idi niku nijamga avasarama, leka just konali anipisthunda ani alochinchu. Oka two days wait chesi konukkodam better, appudu mood maripoyi avasaram ledu anipinchochu.
5.  **Online Shopping apps uninstall cheyyi:** Ni phone nunchi shopping apps ni uninstall cheyyadam tho instant temptation tagguthundi. Browser lo kuda account logout chesi pettu.
6.  **Cash vaadu, card kante:** Chinna chinna expenses ki cash use cheste, nee dagara entha money undi ani physical ga kanipisthundi. Card swiping kante cash vaadithe karchu cheyyadaniki konchem alochisthav.

Ee tips follow ayyi chudu, definite ga nee expenses control chesthav inka savings kuda perugutayi.

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu oka banking application backend develop chesthunna Python Flask lo. Kani chala requests handle chesthunte database connections chala slow ayipothunnayi. Em problem undo, ela fix cheyyalo ardam avvatledu. Konchem help chesthava?
response:
Yaar, banking application ki database connections slow avthunnayi ante, adi mainly database connection pooling leka potam valla avvochu. Flask lo SQLAlchemy vaaduthunnattu unte, Pool for connections ni config cheyyali. Ikkada oka sample code undi, ela cheyyalo chudu:

```python
from flask import Flask
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import QueuePool

app = Flask(__name__)

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test.db" # Ikkada nee actual DB URL ivvu

engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL,
    poolclass=QueuePool, # Connection pooling kosam QueuePool use cheyyali
    pool_size=10,        # Pool lo enni connections maintain cheyyalo
    max_overflow=20,     # Max extra connections, if needed
    pool_timeout=30      # Connection ni teeyadaniki wait time
)

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

@app.route("/")
def hello_world():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Ikkada database operations cheyyi
        result = db.execute("SELECT 'Hello from DB' as message").fetchone()
        return f"Database message: {result.message}"
    finally:
        db.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)
```

Ee `poolclass=QueuePool` ani set cheyyadam chala important. Idi connections ni re-use cheyyadaniki help chestundi, prati request ki kotha connection create cheyyakunda. `pool_size`, `max_overflow`, `pool_timeout` values ni nee application load batti adjust cheyyali. Idi implement chesthe mee application performance improve avthundi, connection overhead taggutundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu oka movie ticket booking app kosam Python lo backend code rasthunna. Andulo, available shows list oka dictionaries list ga undi. Nenu particular date ki and particular movie ki shows matrame filter cheyyali. Ela cheyyalo oka simple script cheppava?
response:
Yaar, easy ga cheyyochu. Neeku oka list of dictionaries unnai kada, prati dictionary lo 'movie_name', 'date', 'time', 'seats_available' ilanti keys untayi ani anukundam. Nee filter logic kosam oka loop vaadi, condition match ayina dictionaries ni oka kotha list loki add cheyyali. Ikkada chudu oka sample script:

```python
def filter_shows(shows_list, target_movie, target_date):
    filtered = []
    for show in shows_list:
        if show['movie_name'] == target_movie and show['date'] == target_date:
            filtered.append(show)
    return filtered

# Sample data
all_shows = [
    {'movie_name': 'RRR', 'date': '2023-11-25', 'time': '10:00 AM', 'seats_available': 50},
    {'movie_name': 'Pushpa', 'date': '2023-11-26', 'time': '02:00 PM', 'seats_available': 100},
    {'movie_name': 'RRR', 'date': '2023-11-25', 'time': '06:00 PM', 'seats_available': 20},
    {'movie_name': 'KGF', 'date': '2023-11-25', 'time': '09:00 PM', 'seats_available': 10},
    {'movie_name': 'Pushpa', 'date': '2023-11-27', 'time': '11:00 AM', 'seats_available': 75},
]

# Filter cheyyadam
desired_movie = 'RRR'
desired_date = '2023-11-25'

filtered_results = filter_shows(all_shows, desired_movie, desired_date)

print(f"'{desired_movie}' movie ki '{desired_date}' date na unna shows:")
for show in filtered_results:
    print(show)
```

Idhi run chesthe neeku `RRR` movie, `2023-11-25` date ki available shows matrame vasthayi. List comprehensions tho kuda cheyyochu, adi inka clean ga untundi.

prompt: Mama, ma cousins andaru intiki vastunnaru ra ee weekend. Andari kosam authentic chicken biryani cheyyali ani plan chesa. Kani naku masala mix chestunnappudu konchem confusion undi. Perfect ga taste ravalante em em masala vaadali, konchem detail ga cheptava?
response:
Arey, chicken biryani ki masala ne main ra. Nenu cheppina proportions follow avvu, superb ga untundi:  

**Marinade ki:**  
* 1 kg chicken  
* 3 tbsp ginger garlic paste  
* 1 cup thick curd (perugu)  
* 1 tbsp red chilli powder (karam)  
* 1 tsp turmeric powder (pasupu)  
* 2 tsp garam masala  
* 1 tsp coriander powder (dhaniyala podi)  
* 1/2 tsp cumin powder (jeelakarra podi)  
* Fresh mint leaves (pudina)  
* Fresh coriander leaves (kothimeera)  
* Green chillies (pachimirapakayalu) - 2-3 slice chesi  
* 1/2 lemon juice  
* Salt (uppu) to taste  
* 2-3 tbsp oil  

**Whole Spices (for oil lo fry cheyyadaniki and rice boil cheyadaniki):**  
* 2-3 cinnamon sticks (dalchina chekka)  
* 4-5 green cardamoms (elakayalu)  
* 3-4 cloves (lavangalu)  
* 2-3 bay leaves (biryani aaku)  
* 1 tsp shahi jeera  

Ee ingredients anni vesi chicken ni at least 2-3 hours marinate cheyyali, night antha cheste inka baguntundi. Fry chesina onions (birista) kuda marinade lo kalipite taste highlight avtundi. Next day rice separate ga cook chesi, chicken meeda layer la vesukoni dum pedithe chaala perfect ga vastundi ra.

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu oka `tasks.py` script rasthunna Python lo. Oka list of dictionaries undi, daanlo task details unnayi. 'pending' status lo unna tasks ni matrame teesukovali. Ela cheyyalo oka simple script cheppava?
response:
Yaar, idi chala simple. List comprehensions use chesi easy ga filter cheyyochu. Oka sample code ichhanu chudu:

```python
tasks = [
    {'id': 1, 'name': 'Report submit cheyyali', 'status': 'completed'},
    {'id': 2, 'name': 'Meeting schedule cheyyali', 'status': 'pending'},
    {'id': 3, 'name': 'Email replies pampali', 'status': 'pending'},
    {'id': 4, 'name': 'Client follow-up cheyyali', 'status': 'completed'},
    {'id': 5, 'name': 'Project proposal rayali', 'status': 'pending'}
]

pending_tasks = [task for task in tasks if task['status'] == 'pending']

for task in pending_tasks:
    print(f"Pending Task ID: {task['id']}, Name: {task['name']}")
```

Ee `pending_tasks` list lo neeku kaavalasina 'pending' status unna tasks matrame untayi. `task['status'] == 'pending'` ani condition petti filter chesa.

Yaar, Andhra style chicken biryani easy ne, tension padaku. Nenu cheptha chudu. Mundu chicken ni manchi marination tho start cheyyali. Ivi try chey:

2.  **Rice:** Basmati rice ni oka 30 minutes soak chesi, tarvata boiling water lo konchem salt, biryani spices (elaichi, lavangam, dalchin chekka) vesi 70% cook chesi drain cheseyi.
3.  **Gravy:** Oka pedda patra lo oil vesi, sliced onions ni golden brown vachhe varaku fry cheyyali. Tarvata remaining allam-ellulli paste, green chillies, tomatoes, pudi masala lu vesi konchem sepu fry chey.
4.  **Layering & Dum:** Oka big vessel lo first konchem gravy, tarvata marinated chicken, aa tarvata half cooked rice, konchem pudina, kothimeera, fried onions, konchem ghee vesi, malli ide process repeat cheyyali. Last lo saffron milk (paalu lo kumkuma puvvu kalipi) konchem top lo sprinkle chesi, tight ga lid petti, low flame meeda oka 20-25 minutes dum cheyyali. Middle lo flame konchem penchi tarvata tagginchu. Adi mana Andhra style chicken biryani. Try chey, chaala taste ga untundi.

prompt: Macha, ee madhya evening intiki vachhaka edaina light workout cheddam ani anukuntunna. Gym ki velladaniki time undatledu, intlone chesukune exercises emaina unte cheppava? Heavy equipment emi lenivi.
response:
Oi, nuvvu intlone cheyyadaniki chaala easy exercises unnayi ra. Oka 20-30 mins roju chesthe chalu, active ga untav. Bodyweight exercises chaala best. Oka routine cheptha chudu:  
  
* **Warm-up (5 mins):** Konchem spot jogging, arm circles, leg swings cheyyi. Body ni ready cheyyali kada.  
* **Squats (3 sets of 12-15 reps):** Neeku telusu kada, legs ki chaala manchi exercise.  
* **Push-ups (3 sets, as many reps as possible):** Start lo knees meeda cheyochu, tarvata normal ki switch avvochu.  
* **Lunges (3 sets of 10-12 reps per leg):** Balance improve avtundi, legs strengthen avthayi.  
* **Plank (3 sets, hold for 30-60 seconds):** Core ki chaala important ra, stomach fat taggadaniki kuda.  
* **Crunches (3 sets of 15-20 reps):** Abs strengthen avthayi.  
* **Cool-down (5 mins):** Konchem stretches cheyyi. Muscles ki relief isthundi.  
  
Ivi cheyyi ra, bore kottakunda untundi, and body kuda active ga untundi. Daily consistency important. Start chesthe neeku neeku difference telustundi.

prompt: Macha, nenu ippudu `dev` branch lo oka big new feature implement chesthunnanu, adhi inka complete avvaledu. Kani urgent ga oka critical bug fix `main` branch loki push cheyyali. Ela cheyyali, na current `dev` work disturb avvakunda?

prompt: Bro, nenu recent ga oka article chadavadam start chesa ra, blockchain gurinchi. Kani andulo 'distributed ledger' ani edho antunnaru. response: Hey Bro, blockchain ante basically oka huge digital ledger ra, but adhi single place lo undadu. Andari computers lo copy untundi. 'Distributed ledger' ante adhe. So, evvaru emi change cheyyaleru, ade daani security secret.

prompt: Bro, nenu oka fresh branch create chesa, oka chinna feature add chesa. Kani ippudu master branch loki merge cheddam ante 'fast-forward merge' avvatledu ani vasthundi. Asalu ee fast-forward merge ante enti, enduku avvatledu?

prompt: Macha, ee madhya work stress chaala ekkuv avutondi ra. Daily targets anni complete cheyalani, office lo chaala pressure. Personal life lo sports academy ki vellali ani undi, kani time dorkatledu. Ilage work chesthe nenu kuda robot aipotanu ani bhayam vesthundi. Work-life balance ela maintain cheyyalo konchem tips cheppava?
response:
Yaar, work pressure anedi chaala common ra. Kani daanini manage cheyyadam important. Konni tips ikkada unnayi, try chey chudu:

1. **Time Blocks Set Cheyyi:** Daily work ki specific time blocks allocate cheyyi. Morning 9 nunchi evening 6 varaku work ki, tarvata nee personal activities ki time pettu. Work time lo distractions ki dooram ga undu.
2. **Priorities Fix Cheyyi:** Edi important work, edi urgent work anedi identify cheyyi. Ala chesthe, first important tasks complete chesi, tarvata migilina vatiki vellochu.
3. **Breaks Teesko:** Work madhyalo chinnaga breaks teesko. Lunch ki bayataki velli ra, leda oka 15 mins tea break teeskoni mind fresh chesuko. Continuous ga work chesthe tiring ga anipisthundi.
4. **Delegation Cheyyi:** Nee team lo evaraina nee work ni share chesukogaligithe, konni tasks vaallaki assign chey. Antha nee meeda veyyaku.
5. **Personal Time ki Place Ivvu:** Sports academy ki velladam, hobbies pursue cheyyadam chaala important. Evening konchem time daanikosam fix chey. Workout chesthe stress kuda tagguthundi. Saturday Sunday work ki dooram ga undi, family tho time spend cheyyi.
6. **No Cheppadam Nerchuko:** Nee meeda ekkuva work veskunelaga evaraina adigithe, polite ga 'No' cheppadam nerchuko. Nuvvu already busy ga unnav ani cheppu.

Ivi follow avvadaniki try chey, nee life inkonchem easy avthundi.
